description: productops.plan_breakdown: an approved PRD broken into phased, sized requirements with technical guidance against the current stack. The expectation pins the overall size and that dependencies point at earlier requirements.

input.brief: PRD: grammar patterns in spaced-repetition review. Scheduler includes recurring error patterns; grammar card with example and correction; marking correct advances the interval. Architecture: review engine is pure functions in packages/learning; the review page is a server component.

reference.summary: A small change in two layers: the review engine learns a second item kind, then the page renders it. No schema change.

phases.name: Engine
phases.goal: The scheduler returns grammar items alongside words

requirements.title: Grammar item kind in the review engine
requirements.description: Recurring error patterns become review items with intervals; tests cover scheduling and advancement.

phases.name: Page
phases.goal: A learner sees and answers a grammar card in review

requirements.title: Grammar card component
requirements.description: Renders the example, the corrected form and the mark buttons; reviewer sees it in a session.

technicalGuidance.current: The review engine schedules vocabulary with a pure spaced-repetition function.
technicalGuidance.recommendation: Reuse the same function for grammar items; a second interval table is not needed yet.
cons: Grammar may deserve longer intervals later

input.brief: PRD: spoken roleplay scenarios on Plus and Premium. Voice mode on scenario threads, TTS for tutor lines, STT for learner replies, same pipeline, quotas per plan. Architecture: speech routes exist and go through OpenRouter; voice is not ledgered; quotas live in packages/domain plans.

reference.summary: Three phases: make voice spend visible, wire the existing speech routes into scenario threads, then gate and quota it by plan.

phases.name: Accounting
phases.goal: Every spoken turn is ledgered before any learner can run one

requirements.title: Ledger voice calls
requirements.description: Speech routes write a ledger row per call with cost in EUR; tests prove a row per call.

phases.name: Voice mode
phases.goal: A learner can run a scenario by voice end to end

requirements.title: Voice toggle on scenario thread
requirements.description: The scenario page exposes voice mode and plays tutor lines through text-to-speech.

requirements.title: Spoken replies through the turn pipeline
requirements.description: A transcribed reply enters the existing turn pipeline and corrections render as in text.

phases.name: Plans
phases.goal: Free sees voice locked; Plus and Premium are quota-counted

requirements.title: Plan gate and quotas
requirements.description: Voice mode checks the plan server-side and counts against the plan's voice quotas.

technicalGuidance.current: Speech already goes through OpenRouter audio models with PCM wrapped as WAV.
technicalGuidance.recommendation: Keep it; adding a second speech provider now would double the ledger work.
cons: Latency is bound to one provider

technicalGuidance.current: Voice calls are neither budgeted nor ledgered.
technicalGuidance.recommendation: Ledger first, in R1, so the budget gate covers voice before it is opened to learners.
cons: Delays the visible feature by one phase

input.brief: PRD: spend by plan on the operator overview. Rollup records plan per call; overview shows a series per plan; totals reconcile. Architecture: cost_rollup_daily is rebuilt hourly by a worker job; the ops app reads it through a database function.

reference.summary: One schema addition, one job change, one chart change. The reconciliation test is the whole point.

phases.name: Data
phases.goal: The rollup carries plan per row and reconciles to the daily total

requirements.title: Plan column on the rollup
requirements.description: Migration described for the operator to write; rollup job fills it; test proves per-plan sums equal the daily total.

phases.name: Overview
phases.goal: An operator sees one series per plan

requirements.title: Per-plan series on the spend chart
requirements.description: The dashboard function returns per-plan rows and the chart draws one series each.

technicalGuidance.current: cost_rollup_daily is rebuilt idempotently every hour from the ledger.
technicalGuidance.recommendation: Add the plan column to the same table rather than a second rollup; the rebuild stays one statement.
cons: Rows before the change need a backfill
